name: ClindocTemporalStatusCodeSystem
title: Clinical Document Temporal Status Code System
publisher: Clinical Document Verification & FHIR Export System
description: Controlled vocabulary defining clinical temporal status of findings, orders, and therapies extracted from clinical documents.

concept.definition: Finding or medication reflecting active, ongoing, or current clinical status at time of encounter.
Finding, prior medical history, or prior therapy documented retrospectively.
Intervention, diagnostic order, or therapy planned for future execution.
Therapy or medication that has been ceased, stopped, or discontinued.
